name: Korona iz list'ev
source:
Roui, a resilient city dandy, a half-educated jeweler and the author of scientific magic articles, dealt with a colossal failure and had to return to his homeland: Latori. Science isn't a thing here, and local shoddy mystical beliefs are really irritating and dejecting to Roui. He dreams to return to his old life... But how can it be possible if you have no money? 

One day, a prosperous local baron commissioned him for a bracelet, a gift for his lovely bride. Roui, in need of the extra coin, graciously accepted the order... But not long afterward he faced a new problem - the Mad Rook, a legendary and mysterious spirit, began to meddle in the lives of the locals, including Roui's. 

This spirit, an entity that plays tricks on mortals once a year, is possessed with strange magic and a dark sense of humor. Roui had no choice - he decided to gather information about the Mad Rook to find out who he really is!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/604330/The_Crown_of_Leaves/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
鲁伊是一位坚韧的城市纨绔子弟，一位受过半学历的珠宝商，也是科学魔法文章的作者，他遭遇了巨大的失败，不得不返回他的祖国：拉托里。这里没有科学，当地伪劣的神秘信仰确实让鲁伊感到恼火和沮丧。他梦想着回到以前的生活……但是没有钱怎么可能呢？

有一天，当地一位富有的男爵委托他制作一只手镯，作为送给他可爱的新娘的礼物。鲁伊需要额外的硬币，他慷慨地接受了订单……但不久之后，他遇到了新的问题——疯狂的鲁克，一个传奇而神秘的灵魂，开始干涉当地人的生活，包括鲁伊的生活。

这个灵魂每年都会对凡人进行一次恶作剧，拥有奇怪的魔法和黑色幽默感。Roui别无选择——他决定收集有关Mad Rook的信息，以查明他到底是谁！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/604330/The_Crown_of_Leaves/]Steam[/url]]
